notes: DESTINYS SPHERE/IRDIS program (Ginski et al. 2020, arXiv:2007.05274) discovered a close (~130 mas) low-mass companion candidate to this old (5-8 Myr) accreting T Tauri star with an unusually compact gas-rich disk; no resolved circumstellar disk signal was detected outside the coronagraph IWA.
